_comment: Full example — areas, layers, ETL flows and document metadata all in use. Everything is optional; take only what you need. If you merged several databases, the table keys become '<label>.<table>' (see ERD_LABEL). The strings below are used verbatim, independent of ERD_LANG — write them in whatever language the document should be in. A Korean version of this file sits next to it as full.ko.spec.json.

doc.title: Storefront DB Schema Reference
doc.intro: Extracted straight from the production database. Every table carries a role and column descriptions.

area_desc.A: Login, permissions and member information. Every order references users.id.
area_desc.B: Products on sale and their options. Price is held per option.
area_desc.C: Orders and payments. Failed payments are kept, so orders ≠ revenue.
area_desc.D: Aggregate tables built by the nightly batch. The source is area C.
